intro.statement: We run air, road, sea and rail freight under one roof and plan every shipment around what it actually needs.
intro.p1: Getting a shipment moving is often the most critical moment in a deal. Your supplier is ready, your customer is waiting and the schedule is tight. We founded Bolt Logistics in 2021 to be the partner you can rely on in exactly those moments.
intro.p2: Every shipment starts with the same question: what is the right way to move this cargo? We compare air, road, sea and rail on cost, time and risk, then give you a clear plan and an upfront price. We don't make promises we can't keep, and if something changes, you hear it from us first.
intro.p3: Our team in Istanbul and our worldwide agent network follow your cargo from origin to delivery. What we're after is not a one-off job but a long-term partnership that gets easier with every shipment.

why.title: Why Bolt Logistics?
why.text: Speed matters in logistics, but it is not enough on its own. Knowing where your cargo is, seeing the cost upfront and working with a team you can actually reach matter just as much.
why.imageAlt: A port with stacked containers and gantry cranes
why.networkText: Our worldwide agent network follows your cargo all the way to its destination.
why.teamText: Operations are run by people who know the transport modes and procedures well.
why.customerText: We give clear answers and treat your shipment as if it were our own.
why.transparencyText: We share the price and the process upfront and flag any change in good time.
why.flexibleText: One-off or recurring, we build the plan around your cargo.
why.technologyText: Digital tools for route and rate planning help us get your quote to you quickly.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: If your question is not here, message us directly.
faq.q1: What information do you need for a quote?
faq.a1: Origin and destination, the type of goods, weight, volume or number of packages, and an estimated loading date. You can send the form even if some details are missing and we will fill the gaps together.
faq.q2: Which transport modes do you offer?
faq.a2: Air, road, sea, rail and intermodal freight, plus warehousing. We will help you decide which one suits your cargo.
faq.q3: What are Incoterms and why do they matter?
faq.a3: Incoterms are international delivery terms that define where transport costs and risk pass from seller to buyer. Choosing the right one prevents unexpected charges.
faq.a3Link: Read the Incoterms guide in Logipedia
faq.a4: On weekdays from 09:00 to 17:00 by phone, WhatsApp or email. Our contact details are at the bottom of every page.

aboutPage.metaDescription: Founded in Istanbul in 2021, Bolt Logistics runs air, road, sea and rail freight under one roof, backed by a global agent network and an experienced team.
aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.lead: Since 2021 we have planned and moved air, road, sea and rail cargo from our base in Istanbul.
aboutPage.story1: Bolt Logistics was founded in Istanbul in 2021. From day one we built strong partnerships with reliable agents around the world, with the aim of delivering logistics to international standards.
aboutPage.story2: Today we offer air, road, sea and rail freight, intermodal solutions and warehousing under one roof. That lets us treat transport modes not as rivals but as options that work together for your cargo.
aboutPage.story3: With a fresh approach and an experienced team, our goal is simple: make our customers’ logistics easier, keep their costs under control and help them stay a step ahead of the competition.
aboutPage.imageAlt: A port with stacked containers and gantry cranes

values.title: Our values
values.text: Four principles we hold to on every shipment.
values.reliabilityText: We stand behind what we promise. If a plan changes, you hear it from us first.
values.transparencyText: We talk openly about price, process and possible risks from the start.
values.speedText: There is a reason for the lightning bolt in our name. We move fast on quotes, planning and communication.
values.partnershipText: We see every shipment as part of a long-term relationship, not a one-off job.

visionPage.metaDescription: The vision, mission and values of Bolt Logistics: reliable, transparent and fast logistics that strengthens our customers’ competitiveness.
visionPage.title: Vision & Mission
visionPage.lead: Where we want to go, and how we plan to get there.

visionPage.mission: To simplify our customers’ logistics and strengthen their competitiveness by planning every shipment with the right mode, a clear price and timely information.

cookiesPage.metaDescription: Which cookies and similar technologies bolt-log.com uses, and how you can manage your preferences.
cookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiesPage.lead: Which cookies and similar technologies our site uses, and how you can manage your preferences.
cookiesPage.s1: Cookies are small text files saved in your browser when you visit a website. The browser’s local storage can be used for similar purposes.
cookiesPage.s2Intro: Our site does not use cookies for advertising or profiling. These are the technologies we use:
cookiesPage.necessary: To remember your cookie choice, an entry called "bolt-consent" is saved in your browser’s local storage. It stays on your device and is never sent to our servers.
cookiesPage.third: The map on our contact page does not load until you click "Show map". When you do, Google Maps loads and Google may use its own cookies.
cookiesPage.analytics: We do not currently use any analytics tool. If we add one for visitor statistics in the future, it will only run if you give consent in the cookie banner.
cookiesPage.s3: You can change your cookie choice at any time with the button below or the "Cookie preferences" link at the bottom of every page. You can also delete or block cookies and local storage entries in your browser settings.
cookiesPage.contactText: For any questions, email us at:

cookieBanner.title: Your cookie choice
cookieBanner.text: We only use what is necessary for the site to work. If we add analytics cookies for visitor statistics in the future, they will only run with your consent.
